# HTTP errors, retries and limits

What each status means, what to retry, and the rate limits.

Sources: llms b5a4ab82. Latest docs: https://docs.meetstream.ai/llms.txt (append `.md` to any page).

## HTTP status

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 / 201 | Success |
| 202 | Accepted and still working (transcript pending; remove_bot in progress) |
| 400 | Bad request: fix the input, never retry as is |
| 401 | Missing or wrong key (REST header: Authorization: Token <key>) |
| 403 | Not allowed for this key or account (for example low credits) |
| 404 | Not found, or a feature not enabled for the account (for example billing balance) |
| 409 | Conflict: deduplication_key used with a different meeting link, a command before bot.inmeeting, a busy pinned login |
| 410 | Retired route (MeetStream-hosted Zoom ZAK/OBF token routes) |
| 422 | Final failure: a failed transcript (do not poll), RTMS outside the US region |
| 429 | Rate limited: wait for Retry-After |
| 500 / 503 | Server side: retry with backoff |
| 507 | create_bot idempotent replay with the same Idempotency-Key: success, no new bot |

## Retry rules

- Retry only 429, 500 and 503, and obey Retry-After.
- Never retry a 400.
- A 422 transcript failure is final: re-run with POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/transcribe and another provider.

## Limits

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| create_bot (prepaid accounts) | 5 per minute and 50 per hour; bots scheduled at least 10 minutes ahead and idempotent replays do not count |
| In-meeting commands | 30 per minute per bot; screenshots 5 per minute |
| GET /bots | At most 50 per page; cursor nextCursor / hasNextPage |
| Calendar events | 1 to 100 per page; cursor next / has_more |
| Presigned media links | Valid for 1 hour |
| join_at | Up to 90 days ahead |

## Idempotency

- Send Idempotency-Key on create_bot: a replay returns 507 (success, same bot).
- deduplication_key in the body: a replay returns 200; the same key with a different meeting link returns 409.

## Error bodies

- Most errors: {"message": ...}.
- In-meeting commands, low credits, dedup conflicts and signed-in logins: {"error", "code", "bot_status", "limit", "retry_after"}. Read both message and error.

Sources: https://docs.meetstream.ai/errors, https://docs.meetstream.ai/guides/features/deduplication-idempotency-keys, https://docs.meetstream.ai/guides/reference/bot-status-and-error-codes
